events.title: Writing group
events.description: Wednesday, 7-9 p.m. Edgewater Books inside Edgewater Public Market No RSVP needed — all are welcome! The Edgewater Books writing group meets on the second Wednesday and fourth Friday of every month. What to expect at each meeting: A few minutes of chit chat to catch up, 15 minutes to go over personal goals for the day and the day’s optional writing prompt, two 45-minute writing sprints, and 15 to 30 minutes to read aloud, ask questions, and give feedback. No requirements to join, just an interest in writing and community!

events.description: Sunday 10/25, 5:30-6:30 p.m. Edgewater Books inside Edgewater Public Market No RSVP needed — all are welcome! From Bookshop.org : Stéphane Bréitwieser is the most prolific art thief of all time. He pulled off more than 200 heists, often in crowded museums in broad daylight.
